rationale: Continuing the authorized source work on the surface that was just reclassified as deferred: reading the library's own transport entry points so the unread responsibility is at least partially bounded. This is a reading step that reduces the surface's extent and names what is still unread; it evaluates nothing for defects and adds no obligation, which the exhausted audit-unit budget would not allow anyway.

feedback.answered: The synchronous part of the in-repo transport is now sourced. NetworkTransport.Consumer returns an internal channel that the main loop reads (net_transport.go 346-348), LocalAddr derives from the stream address, and IsShutdown probes shutdownCh (349-364). AppendEntries, RequestVote, RequestPreVote and TimeoutNow all delegate to genericRPC (468-484), which takes a connection through getConnFromAddressProvider, applies n.timeout as a connection deadline, sends the typed RPC and decodes the typed response; InstallSnapshot has its own path that additionally streams the snapshot body (509-546). AppendEntriesPipeline refuses to pipeline when maxInFlight is below minInFlightForPipelining, returning ErrPipelineReplicationNotSupported, and otherwise builds a netPipeline over one connection with maxInFlight outstanding requests (450-465, newNetPipeline at 814-817). SetHeartbeatHandler stores the fast-path callback under a mutex, and the fatal path there is the mutable callback rather than message handling (298-306). So the deferred surface is narrower than a blanket 'unread transport': its request/response entry points, the pipeline gate and the heartbeat-handler wiring are now mapped.
remaining: The netPipeline internals are still unread: how in-flight requests are bounded, how responses are correlated to requests, and what ordering the pipeline consumer guarantees.
The connection pool lifecycle is still unread: getConn/getPooledConn/returnConn, reconnect and dead-connection handling, and what happens to a pooled connection when an RPC body fails mid-stream.
The listen/dispatch path is still unread: the RPC type dispatch table, per-message-type queueing into consumeCh, and whether any message type is dropped under back-pressure.

TCPTransport's TLS and configuration wiring and InmemTransport's in-process delivery and ordering semantics are still unread; note inmem_transport.go is the transport the captured tests exercise, so its ordering assumptions underpin the harness evidence rather than being library-external.
None of the read parts were evaluated for defects, and no requirement or confirmed result changes on this reading.
feedback.rationale: Recorded as feedback rather than map objects because this reading reduces an existing unread surface without changing any requirement, and no behavior or fact edge is established by it; the surface stays deferred because its protocol-relevant internals (pipeline, pooling, dispatch) remain unread.
